inputs.text: A single game UI icon for a dark fantasy action RPG, square composition, the object centred and filling the frame with a small margin, on a flat solid pure chroma magenta #ff00ff background filling the whole frame, with no scenery behind it. The object is: a four-sided frost lance head trailing a comet. The icon is one square panel with a thin band rim of antique gold #A98A50 running along its square edge, and the one object is painted on the panel alone: nothing else shares the panel, the panel is not split into squares, tiles or compartments, and no second object or smaller icon appears anywhere in the image. Materials: aged bone, pitted iron, rotted leather, with saturated colour reserved for the effect itself and for the enchanted heads. Palette strictly muted: obsidian #171719, charcoal #29282B, ash grey #68666A, bone #C6BDAA, antique gold #A98A50, blood burgundy #642A32. The effect itself carries arcane blue #478CCB and nothing else in the panel glows. Painterly detail combined with physically believable materials, a single consistent light direction from the upper left, one object filling the panel at a comfortable margin.
